title: [AAPS 3.1.0.3-dev-g Build 0569d2ba0a Both AMA and SMB algorithms are activated at the same time.
symptom: Both OpenAPS AMA and OpenAPS SMB algorithms are checked and the second one is left running, occurring after updating AAPS or every so often without apparent cause.
cause: Configuration was saved with an experimental branch like AIMI, causing the APS selection to default to SMB when loading configuration.
fix: Update to a dev version with commit c4353e2e3eb698393aeba587e9a19ab4304ed31e, which resolves the issue.
evidence_quote: let me guess. configuration was saved with some experimental branch like AIMI. If i'm right if you now restore configuration it will be back to SMB
